PLAINTIFF’S REPLY TO DEFENDANT KATIE HALL’S OPPOSITION
TO PLAINTIFF’S RULE 26(d)(1) MOTION

In the prior action, NCMEC and Hall represented that discovery “could give rise to further
litigation from Mr. Ballentine.” Ballentine v. NCMEC, No. 1:26-cv-01341-MSN-WBP, ECF No.
11 at 4. The Declaration makes concrete what NCMEC previously said discovery might reveal.
ECF No. 31 99 3-7. Defendant Hall’s Opposition (ECF No. 46) adopts NCMEC’s Opposition
(ECF No. 33). Plaintiff therefore incorporates his Reply to NCMEC’s Opposition (ECF No. 36)

and submits this additional point in reply.
